title: The Great writer of the century
subtitle: 历史古迹 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）
meta: 主题语境：历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）　|　核心词汇：great　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 great 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1983 the father wrote of ① a great writer of the century in the letter, and everybody in the house said at once that it was ② greater than the one named there the year before. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the father, who never explained anything, had done it for the whole place and gone home; it was the great ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the greatest writer of the century anybody in the house had ever seen, or so the letter for September 1977 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too great to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the neighbour who had come to help; the great ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the chair at the far door, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a great loss to the family, and said that no neighbour in his right mind would call it ⑥ as great as the loss to the family they had once had in the old house. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was great or not, and he said so.

By 1990 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the letter. What the line asked for was ⑦ something great, and nothing besides. The neighbour from the next house called the whole plan ⑧ quite great; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the letter kept the names of the great ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1993, without a word of thanks, she wrote of another great writer of the century in the same letter, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ greater than anybody had expected. ⑩ The greatest loss to the family in the whole house, she said in 1995, was the one she could never quite name; the great ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 伟大（前置定语 a great writer of the century：1983 年父亲在家书里记下的那件伟大的作家）
B. adj. 伟大／极大（比较级 greater than：文中两处，一处比本世纪的伟大作家，一处比预想）
C. adj. 伟大／极大（最高级 the greatest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 伟大（表语 too great to do：母亲觉得它太伟大，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 极大（前置定语 a great loss to the family：叔叔把整件事称作一桩极大的巨大损失）
F. adj. 极大（同级比较 as great as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩家里的巨大损失相比）
G. adj. 极大（后置定语 something great：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 极大（受程度副词修饰 quite great：那位邻居的评价）

items.q: a great writer of the century
the greatest writer of the century anybody
a great loss to the family
The greatest loss to the family in

answers.why: great 意为“伟大”，1983 年父亲在家书里记下的是“一件伟大的作家”，此处作前置定语 a great writer of the century。
great 意为“伟大”，此处用比较级 greater than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
great 意为“伟大”，家书上 九月 那行字说它是老屋里最伟大的一件，故用最高级 the greatest writer of the century。
great 意为“伟大”，母亲认为这件东西“太伟大了，谁也用不上”，too great to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
great 意为“极大”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩极大的巨大损失”，此处作前置定语 a great loss to the family。
great 意为“极大”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩家里的巨大损失一样极大”，同级比较用 as great as。
great 意为“极大”，家书上那半行字要的是“极大的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something great。
great 意为“极大”，邻老屋来的那位邻居认为这套计划“相当极大”，quite 修饰原级 great。
great 意为“极大”，1993 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要极大”，故用比较级 greater than。
great 意为“极大”，母亲 1995 年说的是“整个老屋里最极大的那一桩”，故用最高级 the greatest loss to the family。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1983 年，父亲在家书里记下了一件伟大的作家。（a great writer of the century）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更伟大。（greater than …）
母亲觉得它太伟大，谁也用不上。（too great to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩极大的巨大损失。（a great loss to the family）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩家里的巨大损失一样极大。（as great as …）
到了 1990 年，家书上只剩半行字：要的是一件极大的东西。（something great）
answers: In 1983 the father wrote of a great writer of the century in the letter.
Everybody said it was greater than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too great to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a great loss to the family.
He said nobody would call it as great as the loss to the family they had once had.
By 1990 the letter asked for nothing but something great.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 great 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1983 the father wrote of a great writer of the century in the letter, and nobody forgot it.
It was the greatest writer of the century in the house, or so the letter says.
My mother thought it too great to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a great loss to the family, and nobody argued with him.
The neighbour from the next house called the plan quite great, and everybody laughed.
The great ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
